newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP sees some special Q4 cost factors.
newsitem.headline: BHP sees some special Q4 cost factors.

text.p: Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) Managing Director John Prescott said on Monday there were several special factors independent of asset write-downs that would cut into results for the fourth quarter ending May 31.
These factors included refits of rigs from the North West Shelf gas project and the Griffin project and some expenses linked to a change of BHP's offices in London.
Prescott also later told a media briefing that the abnormal adjustments referred to in earlier statement forecasting difficult trading conditions included abnormal asset writedowns.
"I'm talking about abnormal writedowns," Prescott said, adding however that the market should not assume that there would be a writedown of BHP's poorly performed Magma copper operations.
He said that the costs of the Western Australian rig refits were not of an abnormal nature.
Earlier BHP said its fourth quarter was likely to be below some analysts expectations and that it would include one-off costs.
BHP's share price closed down 40 cents at A$18.92 on Monday.
